scope: Predeclared quality guards for the longer overnight experiments; not an organizer scoring formula
primary_metric: Gaussian 11x11 local SSIM after saved phase/reconstruction PNG roundtrips
pearson_reference: R31 same peak-normalized protocol and selection quadruples
foreground_definition: Target normalized amplitude > 0.1; ratio of mean predicted foreground amplitude to mean target foreground amplitude, same images
decision: Prefer highest selection SSIM among candidates passing both numerical guards and visual review; confirm shortlisted candidates on source-disjoint validation, then freeze one model before opening official dataset test splits
limitations: These guards exclude known dark-peak failure modes; passing them does not imply high reconstruction quality or strong depth separation. Report failures and all candidate results. Do not tune after final test.
excluded_from_release: classical phase teachers or synthesis fallback
